author: Vyasa
original_text:
कर्मण्येवाधिकारस्ते मा फलेषु कदाचन ।
मा कर्मफलहेतुर्भूर्मा ते सङ्गोऽस्त्वकर्मणि ॥
transliteration:
Karmaṇy evādhikāras te mā phaleṣu kadācana
Mā karma-phala-hetur bhūr mā te saṅgo 'stv akarmaṇi
english_translation: You have the right to perform your duty, but never to its fruits. Let not the results be your motive, nor let your attachment be to inaction.
good_morning_message: Step into this day with purpose, not anxiety. Act with devotion, and release the rest.

author: Vyasa
original_text:
योगस्थः कुरु कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा धनञ्जय ।
सिद्ध्यसिद्ध्योः समो भूत्वा समत्वं योग उच्यते ॥
transliteration:
Yogasthaḥ kuru karmāṇi saṅgaṁ tyaktvā dhanañjaya
Siddhyasiddhyoḥ samo bhūtvā samatvaṁ yoga ucyate
english_translation: Perform your duties established in yoga, renouncing attachment. Be even-minded in success and failure — that equanimity is called yoga.
good_morning_message: Rise with equanimity. Let your actions flow from a place of calm balance today.

author: Vyasa
original_text:
उद्धरेदात्मनात्मानं नात्मानमवसादयेत् ।
आत्मैव ह्यात्मनो बन्धुरात्मैव रिपुरात्मनः ॥
transliteration:
Uddhared ātmanātmānaṁ nātmānam avasādayet
Ātmaiva hyātmano bandhur ātmaiva ripur ātmanaḥ
english_translation: Elevate yourself through your own mind, and do not degrade yourself. The mind alone is your friend, and the mind alone is your enemy.
good_morning_message: This morning, be your own best friend. Lift yourself with gentle, steady resolve.

author: Vyasa
original_text:
यदा यदा हि धर्मस्य ग्लानिर्भवति भारत ।
अभ्युत्थानमधर्मस्य तदात्मानं सृजाम्यहम् ॥
transliteration:
Yadā yadā hi dharmasya glānir bhavati Bhārata
Abhyutthānam adharmasya tadātmānaṁ sṛjāmy aham
english_translation: Whenever righteousness declines and unrighteousness rises, O Arjuna, I manifest myself.
good_morning_message: In every age, goodness rises again. Be that renewal in your small corner today.

author: Vyasa
original_text:
अनन्याश्चिन्तयन्तो मां ये जनाः पर्युपासते ।
तेषां नित्याभियुक्तानां योगक्षेमं वहाम्यहम् ॥
transliteration:
Ananyāś cintayanto māṁ ye janāḥ paryupāsate
Teṣāṁ nityābhiyuktānāṁ yoga-kṣemaṁ vahāmy aham
english_translation: For those who worship me with undivided devotion, I carry what they lack and preserve what they have.
good_morning_message: Trust completely. When you give your whole heart to the good, unseen hands hold you.

author: Vyasa
original_text:
सर्वधर्मान्परित्यज्य मामेकं शरणं व्रज ।
अहं त्वा सर्वपापेभ्यो मोक्षयिष्यामि मा शुचः ॥
transliteration:
Sarva-dharmān parityajya mām ekaṁ śaraṇaṁ vraja
Ahaṁ tvā sarva-pāpebhyo mokṣayiṣyāmi mā śucaḥ
english_translation: Abandon all varieties of duty and just surrender unto me alone. I shall deliver you from all sinful reactions — do not fear.
good_morning_message: Let go of your burdens this morning. Surrender the heaviness — you are held.

author: Patanjali
original_text: योगश्चित्तवृत्तिनिरोधः
transliteration: Yogaś citta-vṛtti-nirodhaḥ
english_translation: Yoga is the cessation of the fluctuations of the mind.
good_morning_message: Begin this morning in stillness. Let the waves of thought settle into clarity.

author: Patanjali
original_text: अभ्यासवैराग्याभ्यां तन्निरोधः
transliteration: Abhyāsa-vairāgyābhyāṁ tan-nirodhaḥ
english_translation: The fluctuations of the mind are restrained by practice and by non-attachment.
good_morning_message: Show up consistently and release the outcome. Practice and peace — that is the path.

author: Upanishadic Sage
original_text:
ईशावास्यमिदं सर्वं यत्किञ्च जगत्यां जगत् ।
तेन त्यक्तेन भुञ्जीथा मा गृधः कस्यस्विद्धनम् ॥
transliteration:
Īśāvāsyam idaṁ sarvaṁ yat kiñca jagatyāṁ jagat
Tena tyaktena bhuñjīthā mā gṛdhaḥ kasya svid dhanam
english_translation: All this — whatever moves in this moving world — is pervaded by the Divine. Enjoy through renunciation; do not covet anyone's wealth.
good_morning_message: See the sacred in all things this morning. The world is alive with presence.

author: Upanishadic Sage
original_text:
न तत्र चक्षुर्गच्छति न वाग्गच्छति नो मनः ।
न विद्मो न विजानीमो यथैतदनुशिष्यात् ॥
transliteration:
Na tatra cakṣur gacchati na vāg gacchati no manaḥ
Na vidmo na vijānīmo yathaitad anuśiṣyāt
english_translation: There the eye goes not, nor speech, nor mind. We know not, we understand not how one can teach this.
good_morning_message: Some truths are beyond words. Sit in quiet this morning and let the stillness teach you.

author: Upanishadic Sage
original_text:
उत्तिष्ठत जाग्रत प्राप्य वरान्निबोधत ।
क्षुरस्य धारा निशिता दुरत्यया दुर्गं पथस्तत्कवयो वदन्ति ॥
transliteration:
Uttiṣṭhata jāgrata prāpya varān nibodhata
Kṣurasya dhārā niśitā duratyayā durgaṁ pathas tat kavayo vadanti
english_translation: Arise! Awake! Approach the wise and learn. The path is narrow as a razor's edge — but the sages say it can be crossed.
good_morning_message: Arise and awaken. The path may be steep, but you have everything it takes to walk it.

author: Upanishadic Sage
original_text:
सत्यमेव जयते नानृतं
सत्येन पन्था विततो देवयानः
transliteration:
Satyam eva jayate nānṛtaṁ
Satyena panthā vitato devayānaḥ
english_translation: Truth alone triumphs, not falsehood. By truth the divine path is spread out.
good_morning_message: Walk in truth today — it is the only road that leads anywhere worth going.

author: Upanishadic Sage
original_text: तत्त्वमसि
transliteration: Tat tvam asi
english_translation: That thou art. (You are the infinite — the Self and the universe are one.)
good_morning_message: You are not separate from the vastness of life. This morning, rest in that knowing.

author: Upanishadic Sage
original_text:
सत्यं वद । धर्मं चर ।
स्वाध्यायान्मा प्रमदः ।
transliteration:
Satyaṁ vada. Dharmaṁ cara.
Svādhyāyān mā pramadaḥ.
english_translation: Speak the truth. Follow righteousness. Never neglect your self-study.
good_morning_message: Three pillars for a beautiful day: truth, right action, and quiet reflection.

author: Adi Shankaracharya
original_text:
जन्तूनां नरजन्म दुर्लभमतः पुंस्त्वं ततो विप्रता
तस्माद्वैदिकधर्ममार्गपरता विद्वत्त्वमस्मात्परम् ।
transliteration:
Jantūnāṁ narajanma durlabham ataḥ puṁstvaṁ tato vipratā
Tasmād vaidikadharmamārgaparatā vidvattvam asmāt param
english_translation: Among all births, human birth is rare; rarer still is the life lived in pursuit of wisdom.
good_morning_message: You have been given the rarest gift — a human life and a seeking mind. Use this day well.

author: Adi Shankaracharya
original_text:
शिवः शक्त्या युक्तो यदि भवति शक्तः प्रभवितुं
न चेदेवं देवो न खलु कुशलः स्पन्दितुमपि ।
transliteration:
Śivaḥ śaktyā yukto yadi bhavati śaktaḥ prabhavituṁ
Na ced evaṁ devo na khalu kuśalaḥ spanditum api
english_translation: Shiva united with Shakti is capable of creating the universe — without Her, he cannot even stir.
good_morning_message: When stillness unites with energy, creation happens. Balance your inner calm with purposeful action today.

author: Kalidasa
original_text:
कश्चित्कान्ताविरहगुरुणा स्वाधिकारात्प्रमत्तः
शापेनास्तंगमितमहिमा वर्षभोग्येण भर्तुः
transliteration:
Kaścit kāntā-viraha-guruṇā svādhikārāt pramattaḥ
Śāpenāstaṅgamita-mahimā varṣa-bhogyeṇa bhartuḥ
english_translation: A yaksha, separated from his beloved, his glory dimmed by a year-long curse — sends a message of love across the skies through a passing cloud.
good_morning_message: Like clouds that carry messages of love across vast skies, let your morning carry hope to all you meet.

author: Kalidasa
original_text:
रम्याणि वीक्ष्य मधुरांश्च निशम्य शब्दान्
पर्युत्सुको भवति यत्सुखितोऽपि जन्तुः
transliteration:
Ramyāṇi vīkṣya madhurāṁś ca niśamya śabdān
Paryutsuko bhavati yat sukhito 'pi jantuḥ
english_translation: Even a happy soul becomes wistful upon seeing beautiful sights and hearing sweet sounds — for the heart remembers beauty from lives before.
good_morning_message: Let the beauty of this morning stir something deep within. The world is speaking to your soul.

author: Kalidasa
original_text:
वागर्थाविव संपृक्तौ वागर्थप्रतिपत्तये ।
जगतः पितरौ वन्दे पार्वतीपरमेश्वरौ ॥
transliteration:
Vāgarthāv iva sampṛktau vāgartha-pratipattaye
Jagataḥ pitarau vande Pārvatī-Parameśvarau
english_translation: As word and meaning are inseparably joined — I bow to the divine parents of the world, Parvati and Parameshvara.
good_morning_message: May your words and actions be one today — inseparable, intentional, and true.

author: Bhartrhari
original_text:
पुस्तकस्था तु या विद्या परहस्तगतं धनम् ।
कार्यकाले समुत्पन्ने न सा विद्या न तद्धनम् ॥
transliteration:
Pustakasthā tu yā vidyā para-hasta-gataṁ dhanam
Kārya-kāle samutpanne na sā vidyā na tad-dhanam
english_translation: Knowledge locked in books, and wealth locked in others' hands — when the moment of need arrives, neither is knowledge nor wealth.
good_morning_message: Wisdom lives in your actions, not your memory. Apply something good today.

author: Chanakya (Kautilya)
original_text:
आयुः कर्म च विद्या च वित्तं निधनमेव च ।
पञ्चैतानि हि सृज्यन्ते गर्भस्थस्यैव देहिनः ॥
transliteration:
Āyuḥ karma ca vidyā ca vittaṁ nidhanam eva ca
Pañcaitāni hi sṛjyante garbhastha syaiva dehinaḥ
english_translation: Lifespan, actions, learning, wealth, and the time of death — these five are ordained even while the soul is in the womb.
good_morning_message: Some things are fixed; many are not. Work diligently with what you can shape today.

author: Chanakya (Kautilya)
original_text:
विद्या विवादाय धनं मदाय
शक्तिः परेषां परिपीडनाय ।
खलस्य साधोर्विपरीतमेतत्
ज्ञानाय दानाय च रक्षणाय ॥
transliteration:
Vidyā vivādāya dhanaṁ madāya
Śaktiḥ pareṣāṁ paripīḍanāya
Khalasya sādhor viparītam etat
Jñānāya dānāya ca rakṣaṇāya
english_translation: The wicked use learning for argument, wealth for pride, and power to oppress. The noble use them for wisdom, charity, and protection.
good_morning_message: Let your gifts serve others today. That is what makes a gift noble.

author: Valmiki
original_text:
न दैवं परमित्यार्याः पौरुषे व्यवसायिनः ।
पौरुषाच्च प्रयत्नाच्च फलं प्राप्नुवते नराः ॥
transliteration:
Na daivam param ity āryāḥ pauruṣe vyavasāyinaḥ
Pauruṣāc ca prayatnāc ca phalaṁ prāpnuvate narāḥ
english_translation: The noble say: fate is not supreme. Those who apply effort and personal will win the fruits of their actions.
good_morning_message: Don't wait on fate this morning. Your effort is the magic. Begin.

author: Valmiki
original_text:
उत्साहो बलवानार्य नास्त्युत्साहात्परं बलम् ।
सोत्साहस्य च लोकेषु न किञ्चिदपि दुर्लभम् ॥
transliteration:
Utsāho balavān ārya nāsty utsāhāt paraṁ balam
Sotsāhasya ca lokeṣu na kiñcid api durlabham
english_translation: Enthusiasm is the mightiest force. There is no power higher than enthusiasm. For one full of enthusiasm, nothing in the world is unattainable.
good_morning_message: Rise with enthusiasm today — it is the greatest power you possess.

author: Vyasa
original_text: नहि ज्ञानेन सदृशं पवित्रमिह विद्यते
transliteration: Na hi jñānena sadṛśaṁ pavitram iha vidyate
english_translation: There is nothing in this world as purifying as knowledge.
good_morning_message: Even a few minutes of learning today can purify and elevate the whole day.

author: Sanskrit wisdom tradition
original_text:
अहिंसा परमो धर्मः
धर्म हिंसा तथैव च
transliteration:
Ahiṁsā paramo dharmaḥ
Dharma hiṁsā tathaiva ca
english_translation: Non-violence is the highest virtue — and so, too, is the protection of the righteous.
good_morning_message: Be gentle in word and deed today. Compassion is your highest calling.

author: Sanskrit wisdom tradition
original_text:
उदयेऽस्तमये चैव सन्ध्ययोः सदा नमः ।
एतत्सूर्यस्य यत्तेजस्तत्तेजो विद्धि केशवम् ॥
transliteration:
Udaye 'stamaye caiva sandhyayoḥ sadā namaḥ
Etat sūryasya yat tejas tat tejo viddhi Keśavam
english_translation: Bow to the sun at dawn and dusk. Know that the brilliance of the sun is the brilliance of the Divine.
good_morning_message: Greet the sun with gratitude this morning. Its light is sacred, and so is your day.

author: Sanskrit wisdom tradition
original_text:
काकचेष्टा बकध्यानं श्वाननिद्रा तथैव च ।
अल्पाहारी गृहत्यागी विद्यार्थी पञ्चलक्षणम् ॥
transliteration:
Kāka-ceṣṭā baka-dhyānaṁ śvāna-nidrā tathaiva ca
Alpāhārī gṛha-tyāgī vidyārthī pañca-lakṣaṇam
english_translation: Five marks of a true student: alertness of the crow, focus of the heron, light sleep of the dog, sparing appetite, and wholehearted dedication.
good_morning_message: Be alert, focused, and undistracted this morning. A seeker's spirit lights the whole day.

author: Manu
original_text:
विद्या ददाति विनयं विनयाद्याति पात्रताम् ।
पात्रत्वाद्धनमाप्नोति धनाद्धर्मं ततः सुखम् ॥
transliteration:
Vidyā dadāti vinayaṁ vinayād yāti pātratām
Pātratvadd dhanam āpnoti dhanāddharmaṁ tataḥ sukham
english_translation: Knowledge gives humility; humility gives worthiness; worthiness brings prosperity; prosperity enables righteousness; from righteousness comes joy.
good_morning_message: The cycle of a good life: learn → be humble → earn respect → live rightly → find joy. Begin.

author: Upanishadic Sage
original_text:
असतो मा सद्गमय ।
तमसो मा ज्योतिर्गमय ।
मृत्योर्मा अमृतं गमय ॥
transliteration:
Asato mā sad gamaya
Tamaso mā jyotir gamaya
Mṛtyor mā amṛtaṁ gamaya
english_translation: Lead me from the unreal to the real. Lead me from darkness to light. Lead me from death to immortality.
good_morning_message: May this morning move you from confusion to clarity, from fear to light, from small to infinite.
